guard.note: ANVIL_MENU = new AnvilMenu(0, new Inventory(Minecraft.player)) when null: the wrapped PUTSTATIC, once
getFakeAnvilMenu + setAnvilMenu + getCost: the wrapped method (shadow only)
sets both input slots of the menu it is given (the shadow uses it on JEI's earlier menu)
the declared methods: only getFakeAnvilMenu and clearCache write ANVIL_MENU
JEI's start takes the menu once and hands it to the recipe maker (the deferred lanes keep it)
the recipe maker computes on its own anvilMenu field, not on ANVIL_MENU
JEI's own release at logout (AnvilHelper.clearCache, GrindstoneRecipeMaker.clearCache): the same reset

jei_anvil_menu_player_release.conversion: MixinExtras @WrapOperation on the PUTSTATIC ANVIL_MENU in AnvilHelper.getFakeAnvilMenu (the store runs unchanged; the helper then knows the menu and registers Forge listeners for ClientPlayerNetworkEvent.Clone and LoggingOut once) and @WrapMethod on AnvilHelper.findLevelsCost (unchanged; shadow check only). On a respawn, a dimension change or a logout the menu is released with JEI's own AnvilHelper.clearCache when its fake inventory belongs to a player other than the current one; JEI builds it again for the current player at its next use. Helper bons.furious.patch.jei_fake_menus.FakeMenuRelease (runtime flag jeiAnvilMenuPlayerRelease; shadow: the level costs computed on JEI's earlier menu must be equal). Fix: JEI's static fake anvil kept the player of JEI's start, and its ClientLevel, after every respawn and dimension change until logout.
jei_anvil_menu_player_release.license: MIT (JEI 15.71.0.224 / 15.59.0.212): no JEI code is carried; the mixin wraps one field store and one method of AnvilHelper and calls JEI's own clearCache (helper bons.furious.patch.jei_fake_menus.FakeMenuRelease)

jei_grindstone_menu_player_release.conversion: MixinExtras @WrapOperation on the PUTSTATIC GRINDSTONE_MENU in GrindstoneHelper.getFakeGrindstoneMenu (the store runs unchanged; the helper then knows the menu and registers the same Forge listeners): on a respawn, a dimension change or a logout the menu is released with JEI's own GrindstoneRecipeMaker.clearCache when its fake inventory belongs to a player other than the current one; JEI reads it only at its start, so nothing JEI computes changes. Helper bons.furious.patch.jei_fake_menus.FakeMenuRelease (runtime flag jeiGrindstoneMenuPlayerRelease). Fix: JEI's static fake grindstone kept the player of JEI's start, and its ClientLevel, until logout.
